summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by analyzing Soony's confidential launch data, then building a product (ask-soony) that detects document-vs-SAP contradictions, recommends and executes supplier actions, and scales to other customers.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses launch despite an 'all ok' plan (art book overbooking, failed statue lot, game cards offloaded). Built a poller/agent/inbox app with Teams/push/voice alerts, a Monty-sandbox 'routines' feature with recipe compiler and flow view, 7 demo cards, and a UI redesign in progress. 181 tests passed, but many commits remain unpushed.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored data/ folder (raw, drops, notes, state, img); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed

Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) with no webhooks; changes must be detected by polling and comparing per-file SHA-256, since files get replaced under the same name
Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; work is claimed with a Now line, and branch jonas/alert-platform feeds Akshat's PR #5
Entire hooks only write a checkpoint when repo files change; a session with no repo changes logs 'skipping checkpoint'
Routines are structured recipes (conditions, steps, fixed brake) compiled to Monty sandbox code, which lets the flow chart be generated automatically
scripts/demo_cards.py seeds demo cards from live portal data (only document references are fixed) and supports --reset, which backs up state files and switches routines off
Some UI files (api.ts, Routines.tsx) and the map/main view belong to teammates; coordinate before changing them

code.finding: _costs_money treated an option as free based on its cost text, so an allocation option with cost 'none' could run automatically; fixed to allow only free communication options, never re-plans, allocations or orders
build_activity, escalate and dismiss now record a 'via' value (inbox, voice or routine) for each decision
Added teach_routine voice tool, which only works on decided cards, stores a switched-off draft in routine_drafts.json, and exposes GET /api/routines/drafts
Hang-up delay raised from 0.8 s to 4 s so the buyer can say 'next time just do that'; it is cancelled if the buyer speaks or a tool is running

workflow: Subagents in parallel (UX, UI, jury devil's advocate, data scout, builders) were effective, each with a narrow brief and its own files
Back up state files before resetting demo state, and check that background loops don't silently re-enable routines
Verify UI changes with headless-browser screenshots rather than assuming they render correctly
Keep confidential data and findings out of commits and external services; share artifacts only with the team
Local pip/uv tooling: run lint and tests before each commit, and ask before pushing the accumulated commits

friction: The portal token was missing at the start, which blocked the data step until the user added it
The Routines and Enable alerts buttons overlapped the map legend and the rest of the UI
'Automate cards like this' kept appearing for cards that already had a routine or draft
Monty's API was larger than expected, so it needed several rounds of reading docs and examples
The sandbox type checker rejected the first compiled recipes with mixed text and dict types, requiring explicit conversions
The dashboard contradicted itself (-7 h slack with 'on track', mismatched at-risk counts) and showed raw codes like CMP-GAM-001
Demo card deadlines will already be overdue by 14:00 unless the script is re-run
One recipe test failed because it assumed the wrong option wording from Akshat's adapter
The team's Teams webhook setup was a manual step that depended on organisation permissions
open_items: 13 or more commits on jonas/alert-platform are unpushed and waiting for the user's OK to push into PR #5
Frontend still needs to show activity[].via and read GET /api/routines/drafts
Full UI redesign (launch-control top bar, timeline replacing the world map, map as a Suppliers tab) awaits agreement with Akshat; three design subagents were running
Routines flow view (n8n-style, with last-run counters) was being built and was not yet reviewed
Send the Karton Nowak order and the Boise reply; register sender addresses in portal Settings
Ask Lio whether portal data is the same for all teams and whether actions create files
Run demo_cards.py --reset shortly before the demo to refresh deadlines
Remaining deliverables: demo script, deck and video; hand-in at 12:00 Sunday
